Visit note | 2025-05-01 03:00 PM | Dr. Jannatul Ferdous, Orthopedics | Patient: Mamun Rahman, 29, male. Mr. Rahman presents today explaining he has swelling around his ankle, experiences pain when walking, and suffered a twisted ankle after he twisted while stepping off a bus in Uttara. He works as a tailor and reports no prior joint issues. He denies any numbness or fever. On examination: pain score 4/10, BP 110/70 mmHg, pulse 91 bpm, weight 55 kg. There is mild localized swelling over the lateral malleolus with tenderness, but no bony deformity. Assessment: Ankle sprain. Plan: a prescription was issued for symptom relief. He was advised to rest, apply ice, use compression, and keep the elevation for 48 hours, and use a crepe bandage. Follow-up in 1 week.
